headline: Presentation on the School District Priority One Project and a monthly LeftField status and financial report.
summary: LeftField will present on the School District Priority One Project to date. A monthly status and financial report for the period ending October 2026 is also on the agenda, with a possible motion to accept it for informational purposes.
items: Presentation from LeftField on the School District Priority One Project to date
Monthly status and financial report from LeftField for the period ending October 2026, with a possible motion to accept it for informational purposes
plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON JOINT SCHOOL BUILDINGS 
November 10, 2026 at 5:00 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Bonilla, Fajardo, Thomas 
School Committee Members O'Connell, Turner, Hamer 
 
AGENDA 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Presentation from LeftField regarding the School District Priority One Project to 
date. 
    
2. Monthly status and financial report submitted by LeftField for the period ending 
October 2026. 
If the Committee so desires, a motion is in order to accept the report and 
submit it to the Board of Mayor and Aldermen and Board of School 
Committee for informational purposes. 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
